title: Design-Based Inference for Fuzzy Difference-in-Differences
abstract: arXiv:2611.24402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study fuzzy difference-in-differences designs from a design-based perspective, in which potential outcomes and treatment decisions are fixed and only the assignment of a policy is random, with heterogeneous and possibly unknown assignment probabilities. The Wald-DiD design estimand equals an assignment-weighted complier effect plus contamination from switchers, from changes in always-takers' effects and from trends in untreated outcomes. I derive the conditions under which the estimand holds a clear causal interpretation. The conditions are weaker than parallel trends in both outcomes and treatments. We propose an Anderson--Rubin-type test with a conservative Neyman variance that remains valid under weak first stages, a sensitivity analysis for the complier effect, and estimators for designs with known assignment probabilities. An application to the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment illustrates the results.

translated_title: 模糊双重差分的基于设计推断
translated_abstract: 本文从基于设计的视角研究模糊双重差分设计，其中潜在结果和处理决策是固定的，只有政策的分配是随机的，且分配概率是异质的并可能未知。Wald-DiD设计估计量等于分配加权的依从者效应，再加上来自转换者的污染、来自始终接受者效应变化的污染以及未处理结果趋势的污染。本文推导了该估计量具有明确因果解释的条件，这些条件弱于结果和处理两方面的平行趋势假设。我们提出了一种具有保守Neyman方差的Anderson-Rubin型检验，该检验在弱一阶段下仍然有效；同时提出了针对依从者效应的敏感性分析方法，以及适用于已知分配概率设计的估计量。对俄勒冈健康保险实验的应用展示了这些结果。
tldr: 本文从基于设计的视角研究模糊双重差分设计，提出了在弱一阶段下仍有效的Anderson-Rubin型检验及敏感性分析方法，其所需的因果解释条件弱于结果与处理两方面的平行趋势假设。
en_tdlr: This paper studies fuzzy difference-in-differences designs from a design-based perspective, proposing an Anderson-Rubin-type test with a conservative Neyman variance that remains valid under weak first stages, along with a sensitivity analysis for the complier effect, under conditions weaker than parallel trends in both outcomes and treatments.
